verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS remote-access and IT-management platform like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or a choice of storage location. The pricing, homepage and community items cover other features, and the probes found no machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
